Cubusify · 21 October 2026

Website changes implemented

All 18 illustrated requests are addressed. FAQ sections and answers are retained; only the unwanted “questions” heading suffix was removed. Existing project descriptions and image files are preserved.

Validation

84 pages · 336 browser observations · 0 horizontal-overflow failures · 0 browser script errors

Checked at 320, 390, 768 and 1440 pixels. All 184 FAQ answers remain. Confirmed mobile navigation, FAQ toggling, carousel pause and reduced-motion behavior. Reviewed representative screenshots in light and dark themes.

Frontend build and checks passed. All 211 showcases and original image hashes are preserved. The refreshed SEO report passes 1,680 of 1,680 local checks (10/10 per route).

Local checks do not measure keyword demand, rankings, backlinks or actual organic traffic. Screenshots were captured in desktop Chrome with fixed-width iframe viewports, not physical devices. Mobile-only layout fixes use max-width:600px; global typography and gradients intentionally apply at every width.

Document checklist

ScreenshotRequestImplementedScope
1 ✓Typography throughout the siteReduced oversized introductions and heading sizes, with a smaller editorial scale for blog and project pages. Poppins is preserved and now loads locally.Global
2 ✓Related planning linksPlaced existing contextual links inside a consistent planning-resource panel.Service pages
3 ✓Project reference spacingAdded a readable heading width, introduction spacing and balanced project-card padding.All related-project sections
4 ✓Questions headingRemoved only the “: questions” heading suffix. All FAQ sections and answers remain, following the user’s clarification.Service and industry FAQ headings
5 ✓Project screen galleryKept both original images; used bounded, proportional desktop/mobile previews and consistently spaced captions.All 12 project pages
6 ✓Our Work title gradientsApplied theme-aware gradients and corrected the large headings inside project notes. Project descriptions remain unchanged.All project detail pages
7 ✓AI scope cardsMoved icons above the text and gave descriptions the full card width.Mobile ≤600px
8 ✓About partnership cardStacked the icon and copy, removed the narrow side divider and balanced padding.Mobile ≤600px
9 ✓Header call to actionChanged “Get Quote” to “Discuss your project” in desktop and mobile navigation.Shared header
10 ✓Latest insights heading/linkPlaced “All insights” beneath the section heading and kept its label on one line. Also corrected narrow-screen insight-card overflow.Mobile ≤600px
11 ✓Directory carouselAdded a continuous horizontal loop with equal-width duplicated sets, a pause control and a static, swipeable reduced-motion alternative. The original tablet/desktop carousel remains.Mobile ≤600px
12 ✓Testimonial cardsReduced card width and padding, removed the edge fade and added a mobile pause/resume control.Mobile ≤600px
13 ✓Hire Team model cardsStacked icons above descriptions so content is no longer squeezed into a narrow text column.Mobile ≤600px
14 ✓Founder headingReduced the heading size and removed the forced mobile line break while preserving readable word spacing.Mobile ≤600px
15 ✓Enterprise architecture sectionImproved heading hierarchy, paragraphs, lists, technology cards and challenge spacing; used a single-column mobile layout.Project pages
16 ✓Redundant hero labelsRemoved the repeated “service / Cubusify” labels and equivalent redundant service/team/work hero tags.Relevant hero sections
17 ✓Breadcrumb replacementReplaced the old page-specific trails with one accessible themed component, including Home, linked ancestors and the current page.All 83 inner routes
18 ✓Title gradients across the siteApplied cobalt/cyan gradients to heading text, with light variants on dark surfaces and a forced-colors fallback.Global
